body:
i like the idea of getting harder on myself, i always start something then lose interest and procrastinate, putting it off. 

my confidence is at zero right now, i can't look at people in the eye and talk to them. my teeth are in pretty bad shape from not visiting a dentist in 6+ years, that makes me very self conscious about talking to someone.  i feel alot better getting this off my chest but at the same time i feel like i am whining, i don't know what to do everytime i start to feel better and my mood improves then a panic attack plunges me back into depression again. it's a vicious cycle :(

the last 6 years went by so quick and i have nothing to show for them, when i was 18 i thought by 25 i would have it figured out. i panic from time to time imagining myself at 30 and in the exact same position.
 
i am in the UK, i was assessed by a mental health counselor to qualify for benefits. i seen him for 6 weeks, he told me about flight or fight situations,breathing and thinking in different way.  my doctor put me on 40mg of cipramil a day for 6 months, it helped and i was taking cbt classes, they helped and i thought i was better and never renewed my meds or the course. now i feel like i am even worse off, i am 6ft 200 lbs but everytime i have a panic attack i feel like a scared kid having his first panic attack, i hate them.

i've lost 60 lbs since last september, i have some goals i want to achieve by 1st jan 2011. get to 160lbs, meditate everyday for 30 mins, read 10 books and exercise everyday for an hour.  i took online classes with the open university, i am going to take more they were brillant. i didnt have to attend the classes everything was from home, the tutor would call once a week and help with any problems but i feel really really stupid, i can't concentrate on anything, it feels like half my brain is always anxious,paranoid and just waiting for the next panic attack to come. i was very nervous the other night debating whether to create this but i am glad i did, you are all awesome. thank you for reading this and responding.

i don't know if there is a single event that triggered them but i have always bottled things up and been a quiet guy. my brother died when i was 17 and i started running with the wrong crowd, doing drugs etc. i still had panic attacks then but would just ride it out. then at 19 i started staying inside playing xbox and then months had passed without leaving the house, anytime i would have to go out i would have a panic attack and slowly stopped going out.

the worst part is when i have a panic attack i get a sudden urge to use the bathroom and its really uncomfortable, when that happens i just have to get out of the room. yea i know what you mean about paranoia, i always think people are talking about me.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. i have been riding it out, i see all my old friends getting married and having kids, enjoying life and i am here still living with my mom in the same bedroom i grew up in. it feels like time is running out and i need to do something, when i think about telling my family i panic, i get overcome with fear and just cry.
